01-canvas.status: Rust is running. The canvas is ready.

03a-panel.status: Our command line is drawn. Input comes next.

03b-state.status: The command model owns the text and history.

03c-layout.status: The real dock lays out history and the command field.

03d-input.status: Type Help in the command field and press Enter.

04-input.status: Change the background. The triangle keeps its shape and colour.

05-vertices.status: Six uploaded corners make one rectangle.

06-indices.status: Four shared corners make two triangles.

07-uniforms.status: One view setting moves all four corners.

08-camera.status: Pan and zoom change the view, not the mesh.

09-matrices.status: A matrix carries pan, scale and rotation.

10-depth.status: The nearer pink triangle wins the overlap.

11-scene.status: Scene data owns the meshes; the renderer displays them.

12-identity.status: Selection follows object identity, even when rows move.

13-picking.status: Click a triangle; the visible object is selected.

14-history.status: Undo restores the document while the view stays put.

15-perspective.status: Perspective and picking use the same camera.

16-orbit.status: Orbit moves the eye around a fixed target.

17-solid.status: Kernel geometry becomes an undoable scene object.

18-light.status: Surface direction changes brightness, not geometry.

19-actions.status: Every document action follows the same editor path.

20-resize.status: Canvas pixels, depth and camera resize together.

21-gestures.status: Right-drag to orbit. Left-click to select. A cancelled drag stops immediately.

22-shortcuts.status: Wheel zooms; type commands anywhere in the drawing. Escape cancels a drag.
